product-selector.observed: Homepage quote-start selector (Playwright-verified): tabbed product picker (Popular / Vehicle / Property / Personal / Commercial) exposing ~35 products incl. Car, Homeowners, Renters, Motorcycle, Boat & PWC, ATV, RV, Condo, Flood, Umbrella, Life, Travel, Pet, Jewelry, Bicycle, Mexico Auto, plus a Build My Bundle path. Selecting a product starts that product’s quote flow (auto/property → sales.geico.com; some personal lines → partner underwriters).

agent-locator.observed: Insurance Agent Locator (Playwright-verified on /insurance-agents/): address input + radius select (miles_select) + submit run an agent search; results list nearby GEICO local agents. Also a manage/select control and vendor search.

flipbook.observed: Claims Center (Playwright-verified on /claims/): guided step walkthrough (flipbook) for handling a claim, with claim-type guides (Car Accident, Glass Damage) and CTAs — Report a GEICO Claim, Report Glass Damage, File a Claim with an Insurance Partner, Report a Claim.

virtual-assistant.observed: GEICO Virtual Assistant (Playwright-verified): persistent chat launcher (data-testid="gabby-launcher", button “Open GEICO Virtual Assistant chat”) with a dismissible proactive greeting; opens a conversational support/self-service widget sitewide.
